name: Sun Cleric: Dawn can be canceled to bank remaining Solar Power (#5239)
contract: The selected Spell.dbc gives Dawn 807440 SPELL_ATTR0_NO_AURA_CANCEL. The Sun Cleric runtime contract clears that flag so the native CMSG_CANCEL_AURA request must remove the active phase. This scenario checks aura removal; the dawn-refund scenarios separately check the owner's clarified one-to-one refund on cancellation and expiry.
